module: Submodule of screenshotCreator that generates the thumbnail of a vehicle's current configuration. start() prepares an asynchronous capture: every frame (onPreRender), a coroutine resolves the framing according to the selected mode (framingManager), captures the thumbnail off-screen (5 s maximum delay) then calls the callback with the result. Only one capture can be active at a time.
notes: If the framing cannot be resolved, the callback is called with success = false and the error message as the fourth argument.
The model name is read from vehicle.jbeam or vehicle.JBeam.

start.desc: Starts the thumbnail capture of a vehicle. Refuses (false, "busy") if a capture is already in progress.

outputPath.desc: Path of the image file to produce

callback.desc: callback(success, outputPath, token, errorMessage?) called at the end

token.desc: Value returned as is to the callback

returns.desc: true if the capture is started, false if busy

onPreRender.desc: Hook called every frame before rendering: advances the capture coroutine. On a Lua error, logs the error, releases the capture and calls the callback with success = false.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Hook called on unload: abandons the capture in progress without calling its callback.
